messages:
deploy-bot: 🚀 Starting canary rollout of release v2026.3.2 -> eu-west-prod (10% traffic)
maya: ack — watching SLOs, will ping if p95/p99 moves
leo: attaching quick dashboard: https://dash.redwood/slo/eu-west?range=5m
sanjay: logs show ~30 502s from embed-service on host pool-b-2
maya: interesting — are these new errors or redispatch from upstream?
ops-bot: alert: embed-service 502 spike detected (5m avg) — p95 latency +120ms, error-rate 0.8%
maya: rolling hold: /deploy pause canary
deploy-bot: Canary paused at 10% (manual hold by maya) — reason: embed-service 502 spike
leo: can someone grab traces? `traceroute --service embed-service --since 5m`
sanjay: tail of envoy on pool-b-2: `{"code":502,"upstream":"embed-v3","msg":"upstream reset"}`
nana: tying to the release notes: note about embedding model switch in v3 might be related — pinging infra
ana: small diff in connection pooling flags merged in https://git.redwood/infra/commit/9a1b
maya: ops, can we try routing around pool-b-2? temp routing rule to avoid that host
ops-bot: routing-change queued: exclude pool-b-2 from embed-service LB for traffic from canary (apply in 30s)
leo: SLOs after routing change: p95 dropped to +20ms, errors to 0.1% — dashboard: https://dash.redwood/slo/eu-west?range=1m
sanjay: still seeing occasional 502s (3) from embed-v3 but at lower rate
maya: decision: continue canary for another 15m, keep pinned at previous stable fallback if errors >0.5%
deploy-bot: note: auto-fallback configured — will shift to embed-v2 if embed-v3 error-rate exceeds 1% for 3 consecutive mins
ana: I'll add a release note blurb: "Reverted connection pooling change for embed-v3 in eu-west canary; monitoring" and tag docs
maya: thanks. leaving a reminder to update runbook: add a step to drain pool-b hosts earlier
leo: I'm adding an alert mute for noisy infra engineer pings :sweat_smile:
maya: thanks everyone — marking this thread resolved for now, will update if we need rollback
deploy-bot: Canary resumed to 20% after routing change
maya: we hit 60 minutes in total, errors stayed below threshold. rolling to 50% and scheduling a full rollout at 2am UTC
sanjay: creating follow-up ticket: infra#1234 to investigate pool-b-2 network flakiness
ana: release-notes updated and internal changelog includes pin: `v2026.3.2 -> pinned embed-v2 in eu-west for safety`
maya: closing the canary thread, final status: proceed with staged rollout — no rollback. :thumbsup:
